contexts.text: (Ishmael) mocking () = not agreeing with and favouring the Divine Rational. To mock = that which is of affection against that which does not agree with and favour itself.
To mock us () = that it would rise up against.
Ultimate truth serves as a witness to the natural man against the spiritual, that he had as it were mocked.
Let Pharaoh not add to mock () = that he should not deceive by a lie.
(The Lord's being mocked = the blaspheming of truth.)
That they will deride and blaspheme the truths and goods of the Word, is signified by it shall mock kings, and dominators shall be laughter to it ().
